errors.evidence: The description states that all bars are blue, but the bars for 'OECD' and 'EU27' are colored mauve/purple to highlight them.
The description states the value for EU27 is approximately 65, but the bar clearly reaches the 70% line.
The description states the value for the USA is approximately 67, but the bar is just under the 70% line, at approximately 69-70%.
The description states the value for Italien (Italy) is approximately 64, but the bar is visibly higher, at approximately 67%.
The description states the value for Spanien (Spain) is approximately 62, but the bar is visibly higher, at approximately 66%.

The description claims that the OECD and EU27 data are shown as 'reference values'. The chart visually highlights them with color but does not explicitly label them as reference values; this is an interpretation.

errors.text_span: Die Balken sind nach Ländern sortiert
errors.evidence: The description says the bars are sorted 'by country', which is vague. The bars are clearly sorted in descending order of their value (the employment rate).
The description of the vertical axis omits the tick interval, which is every 10 units.
The bar for Japan is closer to 88%.
The bar for Schweden (Sweden) is clearly on the 80% line, not 82%.
The bar for Deutschland (Germany) is closer to 77%.
